description: Prompts for Experiment 1 (model label) and the text-encoding experiment. Chosen to cover short low-entropy answers, multi-line answers, code, typographic characters and eight languages with accented or composed letters, so that NFD and CRLF variants change some outputs and not others.

prompts.text: What is the capital of Australia? Answer in one word.
Is 97 a prime number? Answer yes or no.
What is 2+2? Reply with the number only.
Who wrote 'Pride and Prejudice'? Give only the name.
In one sentence, what does a cryptographic hash function do?
Explain in three sentences why timestamps matter for documents.
List three uses of Merkle trees, one per line.
Write a haiku about blockchains.
Give step-by-step instructions for boiling an egg as a numbered list.
Write a short email of three lines declining a meeting invitation.
Write a Python function that returns the n-th Fibonacci number.
Write a SQL query that counts the rows of a table called orders.
Write one sentence that uses an em dash and curly quotation marks.
Use the words 'naïve', 'café' and 'Zoë' in one sentence.
Convert 25 degrees Celsius to Fahrenheit and show the formula with the degree sign.
How much might a coffee cost in Paris? Answer with a price using the € sign.
Traduisez en français : « The café near the theatre opens at eight. »
Escribe una frase en español sobre la montaña más alta de España.
Beschreibe in einem Satz auf Deutsch, was eine Blockchain ist.
Напиши одно предложение о городе Алматы.
Қазақстанның астанасы қай қала? Қазақ тілінде жауап бер.
Hãy viết một câu về Hà Nội bằng tiếng Việt.
서울에 대해 한 문장으로 써 주세요.
Escreva uma frase em português sobre São Paulo.
